categories.title: Chansey Supply Shop
categories.info: Chansey Supply Shops sells various battle and medicine items.

categories.title: Clothing Store
categories.info: Clothing Stores sell various cosmetic items.

categories.title: Delibird Presents
categories.info: Delibird Presents sells Pokémon accessories, phone cases and Poké Balls.

categories.title: Food Store
categories.info: Food Stores sells various meals and ingredients.

categories.title: Hairdresser
categories.info: For $3,000, you can change your hairstyle.

categories.title: Pokécenter
categories.info: Poké Centers allow trainers to heal their Pokémon and change their team. They also contain basic shops and TM Machines.

categories.title: Shrine
categories.info: Unseal shrines by finding and removing all 8 corresponding stakes. Then, fight the legendary Pokémon within!

categories.title: Watchtower
categories.info: Once climbed, watchtowers act as Fast Travel points.

categories.title: Gimmighoul (Roaming)
categories.info: Interact with wild roaming Gimmighouls to receive 1 to 10 Gimmighoul Coins. They come back after 24 hours.

categories.title: Ominous Stake
categories.info: Remove all 8 matching stakes to unseal the associated shrine.

categories.title: TM
categories.info: Use TMs to teach Pokémon new compatible moves. Craft them at Poké Centers using the indicated materials, which you can get by defeating their corresponding Wild Pokémon.

categories.title: Battle Item
categories.info: Battle items are useful items that can be used during a battle to increase your Pokémon's stats. Use them when you need an extra boost!

categories.title: Herba Mystica
categories.info: Herba Mystica are rare ingredients used to create sandwiches with enhanced powers.

categories.title: Medicine
categories.info: Medicines are items that can be used to heal your Pokémon inside and outside of battle, or to cure status effects.

categories.title: Poké Ball
categories.info: Pokéballs are used to capture wild Pokémon. Different Pokéball types can increase your catch chance!

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: Treasures are items with no actual use, but they can be sold at shops for a high price.

categories.title: Path of Legends
categories.info: Defeat these Titan Pokémon to gain their Herba Mystica. You will be assisted by Arven in battle.

categories.title: Starfall Street
categories.info: Using the Let's Go Auto Battle feature, defeat 30 Pokémon within 10 minutes to face the boss. You may only bring 3 Pokémon.

categories.title: Victory Road
categories.info: Defeat each Gym Leader to gain their badges. Acquire all 8 to challenge the Elite Four!

categories.title: Trainer
categories.info: Defeat other Trainers for prize money. Their pokemon's levels, and reward you get for defeating them, may change based on your level.

categories.title: Gimmighoul (Chest)
categories.info: Interact with wild Chest Gimmighouls to battle them, potentially capture them and gain 50 to 80 Gimmighoul coins. They do not respawn.

categories.title: Legendary Pokémon
categories.info: Legendary Pokémon can only be fought once, so make sure to capture them!

categories.title: Tera Pokémon
categories.info:
Tera Pokémon are like typical Wild Pokémon, who start the battle Terastallized. Lower their HP to break the Tera state and catch them! 

Tera Pokémon have a chance to respawn every day at midnight.
